markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (67%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged input and MUSK disagreement undercut this call [F6].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 67%, Normal 22%, InSitu 10%, Invasive 1% | Benign leads |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90% level) | Cannot separate them |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.77; OOD 100th percentile | Flagged as suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign; all Normal | Neighbors favor Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score; lowers invasive association · Validated [F2]
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Low score adds small invasive term · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Low score; 0/20 spot check, disregard · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; lowers invasive association · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-3 deletion drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier. Case leans on mitoses (Unreliable).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated blur (severity 3) and OOD 100th percentile may distort both models.
- Benign versus Normal is unresolved; neighbors all lean Normal.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 11** — Confirm stroma is benign without infiltrating tumor cells.
2. **Region 7** — Check ducts for atypical epithelium.
3. **Region 9** — Look directly for mitoses; the model's mitotic score is unreliable.
